title.narrative: Strengthening Competitiveness, Agriculture, Livelihoods, and Environment (SCALE) - Natural Resources Management (NRM)

description.narrative: (Pacific Islands Regional): .This USAID activity contributes to reducing greenhouse gas emissions or improving the conditions to enable such reductions by providing technical assistance and support to help the Solomon Islands improve natural resource management (NRM), particularly forest governance. USAID's SCALE-NRM activity addresses unsustainable forestry practices in the Solomon Islands by strengthening the capacity of community-based organizations to mobilize people and local government structures around sustainable and inclusive NRM initiatives; develop opportunities for alternative livelihoods from agroforestry and conservation; and strengthen local capacity to effectively plan, manage, and protect forests...With FY 2022 funds, USAID will support tribal and community-driven forest restoration projects, assist communities with alternative livelihoods to logging, progress in establishing two payment for ecosystem services schemes, conduct analyses and develop tools to aid decision-making on climate change, continue to work for the passage of two ordinances-the Forest Business License Ordinance and the Environment and Conservation Ordinance-to support conservation efforts, and strengthen provincial- and ward-level institutions in implementing climate mitigation and forest conservation actions. .This activity will contribute to the Indo-Pacific Strategy by strengthening natural resource governance in the Solomon Islands. . .... ...
